records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the exact existing dog identity, camera, proportions and drawing style to preserve. Redesign ONLY small permanent character identity features and expression so its natural magical ability is readable even at rest. ONE dog, full body, top-down three-quarter overhead view about 65 degrees, facing screen bottom-right. Preserve the original unusually SHORT compact chubby body, oversized head, stubby paws, breed colors and markings, thick dark doodle outlines, simple clean flat color with only the original subtle fill texture. Keep same square canvas, scale, body placement and generous transparent empty margin. Genuine transparent background. Original indie game mascot, appealing slightly mischievous attitude, simple shapes legible at a small game size. No text, no logos, no scenery, no ground disk, no cast shadow, no background, no glow or haze, no costume, no hat, no armor, no gun, no device, no detached large VFX. Do not lengthen body, enlarge head, turn into a humanoid, or add extra limbs.
Character: a naturally frost-powered Siberian husky with cool stubborn charisma. Preserve the gray-and-white husky and its exact short body silhouette. Add small sharply faceted icy pale-cyan frost caps directly on the uppermost tips of BOTH triangular ears; each tip has at most one short ice droplet point, still clearly ears, NOT horns, crown, headgear, or giant crystals. Add the same pale-cyan frost to the curled tail's white END only. Keep most fur unchanged. Change the eyes to an icy blue half-lidded focused look with subtly raised outer brow and a tiny self-assured off-center mouth curve. The ear frost should read clearly from the overhead camera, with 2-3 bold simple facets and dark blue outlines matching the doodle line weight. Add only two tiny frost specks stuck on cheek fur. This is a resting representative character, no breath cone or floating snowflake.
records.visualCheck: Ear-tip and tail-tip frost; small cheek crystals; icy half-lidded eyes; breed identity and short body preserved.
